snippet.title: Frostpunk 2 | Console Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10008442/ 
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/frostpunk-2/9N0KN24FWP6B 

#Frostpunk2 arrives on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on September 18, 2025, with full controller support on consoles and PC.

And there’s more warmth in the air - to ensure every citizen their lawfully given access to goods, the game is launching with physical editions, carefully overseen in collaboration with Skybound Games on both consoles.
